Resolves #20177

`.github/workflows/lint-guides.yml` runs the Brain's guide-quality lint over this repository's guides again. It checks out this repository and `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` at `dev` side by side, then runs `node brain/ai/scripts/lint/lint-guides.mjs --root engine`. It triggers on `dev` pull requests and pushes that touch `learn/**`, `package.json` or the workflow. There is no `npm ci`, because the lint uses only Node built-ins.

The three hard findings that accumulated while nothing ran are rewritten:
- two ticket ids in `PooledGridAnimation.md`;
- `WhiteboxE2E.md`'s retry paragraph, which now describes the bridge by its declaration in `e2eCiSelection.mjs`. Its last day has passed, so the tier runs without retries.

Evidence: L2 (the lint run locally against this branch and its base, plus this PR's own run of the workflow) → L2 required (the workflow's run on a `learn/**` PR is the property under test). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: this PR touches `learn/**`, so its "Guide Lint" check is the workflow running over this repository's guides. On base `3918aa1474` the same command fails with 3 hard findings and exit 1. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the "Guide Lint" check at this PR's head (0 hard, 5 warnings). |
| AC-3 | Diff: `WhiteboxE2E.md` says the tier runs without retries, says a test red on its one attempt stays red, and names `BRAIN_RETRY_BRIDGE` in `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`. It cites no ticket. |
